title: Pronouns
description: Subject, object, possessive adjectives, possessive pronouns, reflexive

subject_object: You need to follow me closely.
Yousef, Hussien and Basil were cross because they had waited ages.
Essam watched the children carefully as they crossed the road.
Hold the bag please while I put the shopping in it.
Wafa and I are going soon so you can come with us.
I wonder why Rashed rushed off. Did you upset him?
Sarah wanted Leen to follow her.
possessive: Ahmad has already eaten his lunch, but I'm saving mine.
My mobile needs to be fixed, but his is working.
My computer is Mac, but yours is PC.
We gave them our telephone number, and they gave us theirs.
My pencil is broken. Can I borrow yours?
My car is cheap, but hers is expensive.
You can't have any chocolate! It's all mine.
reflexive: Every morning I wash myself and clean my teeth.
Fatima is too small to eat by herself.
Khalid always copies his friends' homework and never does it by himself.
The children can decorate the pages all by themselves.
Jawaher and I can paint the car all by ourselves.
Aisha is looking at herself in the mirror.
You can comb your hair by yourself now.
Please come in and make yourselves at home.
If you can't do this exercise by yourself, ask your teacher.
